model.rawSql:
SELECT Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] AS service,
  if(max(TimeUnix) < now() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE, 0, argMax(Value, TimeUnix)) AS up
FROM otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND MetricName = 'cnpg_collector_up' AND service != ''
GROUP BY service

annotations.description: The CloudNativePG exporter of managed service {{ $labels.service }} can't reach Postgres, or has sent no metrics for 10 minutes.

model.rawSql:
SELECT conn.service AS service, conn.v / maxconn.v AS usage
FROM (SELECT service, sum(v) AS v FROM (SELECT Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] AS service, toString(Attributes) AS series, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v
  FROM otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND MetricName = 'cnpg_backends_total'
  GROUP BY service, series) GROUP BY service) AS conn
JOIN (SELECT service, max(v) AS v FROM (SELECT Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] AS service, toString(Attributes) AS series, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v
  FROM otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND MetricName = 'cnpg_pg_settings_setting' AND Attributes['name'] = 'max_connections'
  GROUP BY service, series) GROUP BY service) AS maxconn USING service
WHERE maxconn.v > 0

annotations.summary: Postgres {{ $labels.service }} uses {{ humanizePercentage $values.A.Value }} of its connections
annotations.description: New connections are refused once max_connections is reached.

model.rawSql:
SELECT service, max(v) AS lag FROM (SELECT Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] AS service, toString(Attributes) AS series, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v
  FROM otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND MetricName = 'cnpg_pg_replication_lag'
  GROUP BY service, series) GROUP BY service

annotations.description: A replica is more than a minute behind the primary; reads from it are stale and a failover may lose data.

model.rawSql:
SELECT service, max(f) AS failures FROM (SELECT Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] AS service, max(Value) - min(Value) AS f
  FROM otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE AND MetricName = 'cnpg_pg_stat_archiver_failed_count' AND service != ''
  GROUP BY service, toString(Attributes)) GROUP BY service

annotations.description: WAL that isn't archived can't be restored, and piles up on the volume until it is full.

model.rawSql:
SELECT service, max(v) AS age FROM (SELECT Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] AS service, toString(Attributes) AS series, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v
  FROM otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND MetricName = 'cnpg_pg_database_xid_age'
  GROUP BY service, series) GROUP BY service

annotations.summary: Postgres {{ $labels.service }} is at transaction ID age {{ $values.A.Value }}
annotations.description: Postgres stops accepting writes near 2 billion; autovacuum has to freeze old rows before then.

model.rawSql:
SELECT concat(service, ' ', pvc) AS volume, service, max(used) AS usage FROM (
  SELECT ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS pod, ResourceAttributes['k8s.persistentvolumeclaim.name'] AS pvc,
    1 - argMaxIf(Value, TimeUnix, MetricName = 'k8s.volume.available') / argMaxIf(Value, TimeUnix, MetricName = 'k8s.volume.capacity') AS used
  FROM otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND MetricName IN ('k8s.volume.available', 'k8s.volume.capacity') AND pvc != ''
  GROUP BY pod, pvc
) AS m JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT Attributes['pod'] AS pod, Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] AS service FROM otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND MetricName = 'cnpg_collector_up') AS p USING pod
WHERE isFinite(used)
GROUP BY volume, service

annotations.description: Postgres stops accepting writes when its data or WAL volume is full. Raise the storage of the plan, or delete data.

rules.title: Postgres transaction running for over an hour

model.rawSql:
SELECT Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] AS service, max(Value) AS seconds FROM otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND MetricName = 'cnpg_backends_max_tx_duration_seconds' AND service != ''
GROUP BY service

annotations.summary: Postgres {{ $labels.service }} has a transaction open for {{ humanizeDuration $values.A.Value }}
annotations.description: Long transactions hold back vacuum, so tables and indexes bloat, and they can hold locks other queries wait for.

model.rawSql:
SELECT LogAttributes['targetId'] AS service, if(EventName != '', EventName, LogAttributes['event.name']) AS event, count() AS failures FROM otel_logs
WHERE Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE AND ServiceName = 'marketplace' AND LogAttributes['provider'] IN ('postgres', 'ferretdb', 'babelfish') AND SeverityNumber >= 17
GROUP BY service, event

annotations.description: The marketplace logged an error event for this service, like a failed backup. The event log in the "Postgres logs and events" dashboard has the message.
